rules.title: Rules & policies
rules.lede: How play is settled, how outcomes can be checked, and the conditions every account agrees to. If something here contradicts what the software does, the software is the bug — tell support.
rules.draftBody: These are the house rules as the platform is currently built. They are a plain-English description of live behaviour, not a lawyer-reviewed terms of service, privacy policy or licence condition. Have them reviewed before the site takes real money in any regulated market.
rules.termsBody: Opening an account means you accept these rules. One account per person. Accounts are personal: you may not sell, share or transfer one, and you are responsible for everything done with your credentials.
rules.stakesServerLead: Every outcome is decided by the server.
rules.stakesServerBody: The browser animates a result it has already been given; nothing you can do in the client changes what was rolled.
rules.stakesLedgerLead: Balances move only through the ledger.
rules.stakesLedgerBody: A stake is debited when the bet is accepted and a win is credited when the round settles, both inside a single database transaction.
rules.stakesFinalBody: Where a round is interrupted — connection lost mid-hand, server restarted — it settles on the outcome already committed to, not on what was on screen.
rules.stakesLimitsBody: apply per game and are shown on each bet control. Bets outside them are rejected before any money moves.
rules.suspensionBody: Accounts may be frozen where there is evidence of collusion, abuse of bonuses, automated play against the game APIs, or where required by the AML checks below. A frozen account can still sign in and read its history; it cannot place bets or withdraw until the matter is closed.
rules.fairBody: Every result comes from a seed pair that is committed to before you bet, so the house cannot pick an outcome after seeing your stake and you cannot predict one before placing it.
rules.fairServerBody: Generated for you and kept secret while the pair is live. Its SHA-256 hash is published immediately — that hash is the commitment.
rules.fairClientBody: Yours, and changeable at any time from the fairness dialog.
rules.fairNonceBody: Increments once per bet, so the same pair never produces the same roll twice.
rules.fairRevealBody: The server seed is disclosed when the pair is rotated. Hash it and compare against the commitment you were given at the start — if they match, the seed could not have been swapped mid-pair.
rules.fairNote: A live server seed is never sent to a browser. Sending one would let the holder compute every future round on that pair, which is why the reveal only happens on rotation. Rotate your pair whenever you like from the fairness dialog on any game.
rules.ageBadgeBody: This service is for adults only. You must be at least 18, or the legal gambling age where you live if that is higher. Accounts found to belong to minors are closed and stakes are returned.
rules.ageBody: Gambling can be addictive. Set limits before you play, treat losses as the cost of the entertainment rather than something to chase, and stop when it stops being fun. If it has become a problem, contact support to have your account closed — a request to close for that reason is never refused and never delayed.
rules.amlBody: Deposits and withdrawals are monitored. The purpose of these controls is to stop the platform being used to move the proceeds of crime, and they apply to every account regardless of size or standing.
rules.amlSourceBody: We may ask where deposited funds came from, and hold a withdrawal until the answer is satisfactory.
rules.amlIdentityBody: Verification may be required before a withdrawal is released, and may be re-run if account activity changes materially.
rules.amlRouteBody: Funds return the way they arrived wherever possible. Third-party withdrawal addresses are not accepted.
rules.amlPassBody: Depositing and immediately withdrawing with little or no play is treated as a money-transmission attempt, not as gambling, and is escalated for review.
rules.amlReportBody: Suspicious activity is reported to the relevant authority. We are not permitted to tell you when such a report has been made.
rules.gamesBody: Each game states its own limits and payouts on the board. The shared rules are:
rules.gamesCrashBody: A multiplier climbs from 1.00x until it breaks. Cash out before the break to take the stake times the multiplier at the moment you pressed; if it breaks first, the stake is lost.
rules.gamesMinesBody: Reveal tiles on a grid for a rising multiplier. Any mine ends the round. Cash out at any point to bank the current value.
rules.gamesDiceBody: Pick a target; the payout is priced off the chance of hitting it, so a longer shot pays more.
rules.gamesTableBody: Standard rules with the paytable shown on each board.
rules.gamesSlotsBody: Five reels, five fixed paylines. Wins pay left to right from reel one; the paytable is on the board.
rules.gamesPracticeBody: Chicken Road and Avia Masters currently roll their outcomes in the browser and settle no money. They are marked as practice on the board itself and cannot be played for stakes.
rules.malfunction: Malfunction voids all pays and plays. Where a defect causes a payout the paytable does not support, the round is corrected and the ledger adjusted, with the adjustment recorded against your account.
rules.orSupport: or reach support from the sidebar.

arch.title: How it works
arch.lede: A casino asks you to trust that the result was not chosen after you placed the bet. FRIGAT is built so you do not have to take that on faith: the outcome of every round is committed to before you play, and you can check it afterwards yourself.
arch.lifeBody: Four steps, in this order, every time. The order is the point — the result exists before your browser draws a single frame of it.
arch.diagramAria: Round flow: committed seed, server engine resolves, ledger settles, client animates
arch.s1Title: 1 · The seed is committed before you bet
arch.s1p1a: Each account holds a seed pair. The
arch.s1p1c: is generated for you and kept secret while the pair is live — but its SHA-256 hash is published to you immediately. That hash is a promise: it fixes the seed without revealing it.
arch.s1p2c: is yours and you can change it whenever you like. A
arch.s1p2e: counts up with every bet, so the same pair never produces the same roll twice. Outcome = f(server seed, your seed, nonce) — and two of those three are yours.
arch.s1p3: A live server seed is never sent to a browser. Anyone holding it could compute every future round on that pair, which is why it is disclosed only when the pair is rotated.
arch.s2Title: 2 · The server decides, the browser draws
arch.s2p1: Every result is computed on the server from the committed seed before your client renders a frame. The reels, the curve, the cards — those are choreography over a result that already exists.
arch.s2p2: A message from your browser never carries an outcome. It carries an intent — this stake, this game, this target — and the server answers with what happened. That is why a modified client, a slow connection or a closed tab cannot change what a round paid.
arch.s3p1: Balances are stored and transported as exact decimal values to eight places, never as floating-point numbers. Floats are fine for graphics and wrong for money: they lose fractions of a cent, and those fractions are somebody's.
arch.s3p2: A stake is debited and a win credited inside a single database transaction. Either both happen or neither does — there is no window in which your stake has left but the result has not landed.
arch.s4p1: Open the fairness dialog on any game. It shows the hash you were given, your client seed and the current nonce. Rotate the pair and the server seed is revealed:
arch.s4li1: Hash the revealed server seed and compare it against the commitment you were shown before you played. If they match, the seed cannot have been swapped after the fact.
arch.s4li2: Re-derive any round from the revealed seed, your client seed and that round's nonce, and confirm it produces the result you were paid on.
arch.s4p2: Both checks are arithmetic anyone can run — they do not depend on trusting this page.
arch.s4Link: The full policy is in the rules
arch.gapTitle: Where this does not apply yet
arch.gapBodyC: currently roll their outcomes in the browser and settle no money. They are labelled as practice on the board itself and cannot be played for stakes. They will join the scheme above when their engines move server-side; until then they are not covered by any of it, and we would rather say so here than let the claim quietly cover them.

promos.title: Promotions
promos.lede: Everything below is live and pays into your real balance. Bonuses are credited by the server when you claim them — there is no bonus wallet and no wagering requirement to clear first.
promos.signedOutBody: These offers are tied to an account.
promos.wheelBlurb: One free spin every day, credited straight to your balance.
promos.wheelDetail: Resets 24 hours after your last spin. The prize is drawn from the same committed seed scheme the games use, so the segment you land on was fixed before the wheel started turning.
promos.rakebackBlurb: A percentage of everything you wager comes back, win or lose.
promos.rakebackDetail: The rate rises with your tier — from 5% at Bronze to 10% at Platinum and above. It accrues on every settled bet and can be claimed whenever there is a balance to take.
promos.cashbackBlurb: Play on consecutive days and take a share of net losses back.
promos.cashbackDetail: Quoted fresh by the server each time you open it, and claimable once per day. Breaking the streak resets the multiplier, not your history.
promos.partnerBlurb: Earn a cut of what everyone you invite wagers, for as long as they play.
promos.partnerDetail: Tiered revenue share paid into a separate affiliate balance you can claim at any time. No cap on referrals and no expiry on the link.
promos.howServerBody: Whatever a page shows you is a display of that same calculation, never an input to it — so a stale tab cannot claim yesterday’s figure.
promos.howOnceBody: A second attempt in the same window is refused rather than double-paid.
promos.howCreditBody: through the ledger, in the same transaction that marks the bonus as taken.
promos.howAbuseBody: Multiple accounts, self-referral, or deposit-and-withdraw cycles with no play forfeit outstanding bonuses — see
promos.toppingUp: Topping up? The cashier lives in the header once you are on the casino.

partner.title: Partner program
partner.lede: Send players to FRIGAT and earn a share of what they lose, for as long as they keep playing. No cap on referrals, no expiry on your link, and earnings land in a separate balance you can draw down whenever you like.
partner.commissionBodyA: Revenue share is paid on the
partner.commissionBodyB: of players who signed up through your link — not on their deposits and not on turnover, so the number moves with the same figure the house books.
partner.bandsNote: Every account starts at the standard rate. Bands above it are set per account by the affiliate team rather than granted automatically — reach out once you are sending consistent volume and we will move you up.
partner.dashboardIntroA: Live figures for your account. The full breakdown, including claiming, lives on
partner.trackingNote: Tracking is real-time: invited players, how many have deposited, and the balance available to claim, all updated as rounds settle.
partner.signInForFigures: Sign in to see your own figures here.
partner.linkNote: Anyone who registers through this link is attributed to you permanently. Share it anywhere you like.
partner.noApplicationA: There is no application to fill in:
partner.everyAccount: every account is a partner account
partner.noApplicationB: Registering issues you a referral code, and your link works from that moment.

partner.termsTrafficBody: Promising players a cut of your commission, or advertising odds and offers this site does not run, voids earnings.
